# Support & Community Guidelines

Thank you for using **Formula Rate Shipping for WooCommerce**!

## Passion Project Notice & Support Boundary

Formula Rate Shipping is an independent, free open-source e-commerce plugin created and maintained by **David @ RemarkablePC**. 

Because this tool is provided 100% free of charge and maintained during personal time:

* **No 1-on-1 Technical Support**: We cannot provide private debugging, personal store formula audits, carrier API troubleshooting, or direct assistance via email, phone, or website contact forms.
* **No SLAs or Guaranteed Response Times**: Inquiries are reviewed purely at the creator's discretion and personal availability.

## Where to Connect & Get Help

* **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/remarkablepc/Formula-Rate-Shipping/discussions)**: Want to discuss complex formula expressions, folded incremental mixed-cart setups, or share shipping rules? Join fellow store owners in GitHub Discussions.
* **Documentation & Simulator**: Explore our [README.md](README.md) and use the interactive live simulator built directly into the WooCommerce settings screen (**WooCommerce -> Settings -> Shipping -> Shipping Zones**) to test and validate your formulas.

## How to Support the Project

If Formula Rate Shipping solved your store's shipping challenges and saved your business from expensive monthly SaaS fees, consider supporting ongoing development:
